purpose: Map <smoke-worktree> placeholder in captured request packets to relative topic paths. Absolute personal worktree paths stay out of the tracked tree.
path_style: Windows Path.resolve() (backslash separators) when expanded locally
generation_rule: roundtable.packet.build → (TopicPaths scratch/snapshot).resolve(); handoff._capture_request freezes snapshot under requests/<inv>.snapshot.md

provenance.windows_user_layout: Historical personal_path_scan originals used a Windows user profile under Projects/Documents/.repos/nexus_ai/... (see git history before e4c5f88).
provenance.repo_name: Public repo sync path convention: docs/operations/mac-handoff.md → $HOME/Projects/Documents/.repos/nexus_ai/ai-round-table.
provenance.note: Commit 0e18b51 recorded packets with <smoke-worktree> redaction; a189e6a briefly restored absolute paths for investigation; this file keeps the placeholder + relative suffixes so personal_path_scan stays clean.

verification: SHA-256 of each tracked requests/*.md body must equal packets.*.redacted_sha256.
Every absolute path token in those bodies must be the placeholder <smoke-worktree>, not a user-profile path.
Relative suffixes under the local clone root must match files tracked in this topic (requests/*.snapshot.md) and the scratch contract paths.
